answer: A depreciating bond bleeds fakes dry: each costs 120 units and locks 10 epochs, loses 4% per epoch, and below 60 it downgrades and loses rewards. An umber audit trail marks bulk bond buys, a marble registry stops the same funds backing two bonds, and a cedar chain ties each bond to one credential. Forging 1,000 costs 120,000 units, loses 4,800 per epoch; after 10 idle epochs the farm is down 40,000, while honest agents refresh bonds working.
